title: ACT ON MANAGEMENT OF FIREFIGHTING EQUIPMENT
full_text:
Article 21 (Inspection and Examination of Fire Equipment) (1) When purchasing fire equipment, the head of a fire service agency shall inspect and examine the fire equipment to check quality, physical properties, external appearance, dimensions, quantity, performance, etc. of the fire equipment.
  (2) In cases of inspection and examination pursuant to paragraph (1), the head of a fire service agency may organize a special inspection team comprised of fire officials and relevant experts and have it inspect or examine the fire equipment, as prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety.
  (3) Where purchasing fire equipment determined by Presidential Decree such as fire engines, etc., the head of a fire service agency shall require a specialized institution for fire equipment designated by the Fire Commissioner of the National Fire Agency to perform inspection, etc. thereof on his or her behalf.
